column3: “If they confess” renders “and they will confess.”
“I also was acting” renders the future “I also will walk,” and “make amends for” renders “accept (pay off).”
“My covenant with Jacob” renders “my covenant of Jacob” (likewise for Isaac and Abraham).
“make up for” and “making amends for” render the same verb, “accept (pay off).”
“to destroy them” renders “to make an end of them.”
